document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You make your way through Esbury’s streets, confirming your 
whereabouts every so often by approaching a building to check 
the address against the location you’re searching for.

After some time, you arrive at Joshua’s house. You insert the 
key in the lock and open the door into a small living area.

Glancing around, you see a compact living room and kitchen. 
There are two doors at opposite ends of the common area. The 
door to your left is wide open and you can see a set of stairs 
leading down. The door to your right is closed. You assume it 
leads to the bedroom.
• To head down the stairs, go to 156.
• To head into the bedroom, go to 202.
